description: One bot by id: its settings, status and record. include trades adds its trades (last 30 days, counted as rows; each carries the bot's rule when it made it, as saved then); activity adds how often its trigger fires. A live bot's record and trades are its real orders, priced at the venue now, and it adds live: its limits, newest orders with the reason any did not fill, and the trades it skipped in the last 24 hours and why.

id.description: The bot id from list_bots, e.g. signal:<uuid>.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.

since.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, e.g. 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z. Trades reach back 30 days.

name: get_bot
title: One bot
